answer: Make every newcomer buy underwriting. An established agent posts a bond as the newcomer's insurer and charges a premium; if the newcomer is later proven to be one head of a farm, the bond pays out to whoever exposed it. Insurers price risk, so a batch of fresh heads with shared funding sees premiums climb to their zenith, while an agent with a clean record becomes an anchor whose premium falls each epoch. Free identities that once blew in like a zephyr now carry a real price.
